theorem.reason: the charge generator is scalar, so its commutant is the full End(C^2) and gauge covariance permits Dirac-Majorana mixing
theorem.realityUnitaryUpgrade: for an anti-Hermitian connection, one-sided invariance implies the adjoint condition and hence [A,Z_M]=0
theorem.conclusion: the Majorana-only subbundle is preserved exactly when the constant sector projector is parallel

curvatureInterpretation.parallelCase: connection and curvature split into independent Dirac and Majorana blocks
curvatureInterpretation.nonparallelCase: the off-diagonal second fundamental form is the exact spurion that transports an allowed Majorana section into the forbidden Dirac channel

reality.chargeMinusThreeFiber: use the conjugate connection on the J-paired relation fiber
reality.effect: the projector criterion is preserved by the real pairing

boundary: this constructs the minimal connection kinematics and identifies the necessary extra datum; it does not derive the sector projector, its dynamics, or a full Pati-Salam spectral action
verdict: the smallest viable middle is an equal-charge relation bundle equipped with a parallel Dirac/Majorana sector projector; charge covariance alone is provably insufficient
